name: valuation
notes: Works on opaque (storeId, itemId) keys and knows nothing of inventory tables, projects or ledgers; inventory calls it, never the reverse. Reads item to category mapping through master data. Policy changes use the approval document type valuation_policy (rule seeded in migration 0008). H-07 default used: company policy weighted average from 2000-01-01, no category overrides. Beyond the spec's data model the module adds val_keys (current method of a key and its last posting date, also the lock row), val_return_parts (what each return gave back of each consumed part, BR-9) and val_layers.remaining_value (BR-5 value tracking). It also emits valuation.movement.recorded so that every mutation writes an outbox row (constitution 11).
